tools.name: justcall_list_calls
tools.description: List calls on the account, optionally filtered by agent, direction, contact number, JustCall number and date range. Returns call ids, direction, status, duration and timestamps. GET /v2.1/calls.

tools.name: justcall_get_call
tools.description: Get one call by id: duration, direction, status, timestamps, notes and disposition. GET /v2.1/calls/{id}.

tools.name: justcall_get_call_journey
tools.description: Get the journey of a completed call: the ring and routing steps it went through. Not available while a call is in progress. GET /v2.1/calls/{id}/journey.

tools.name: justcall_get_call_voice_agent
tools.description: Get the AI voice agent insights and metadata for a completed call. Not available while a call is in progress. GET /v2.1/calls/{id}/voice-agent.

tools.name: justcall_get_account_call_analytics
tools.description: Get account-level call analytics for a date range: call volume, average ring time, total duration, SLA performance, connect and answer rates. GET /v2.1/calls/analytics/account.

tools.name: justcall_list_contacts
tools.description: List contacts, optionally filtered by name, phone number or status. By default only the owner's contacts; set across_team to include every agent's contacts. GET /v2.1/contacts.

tools.name: justcall_get_contact
tools.description: Get one contact by id, including its notes and other phone numbers. GET /v2.1/contacts/{id}.

tools.name: justcall_create_contact
tools.description: Create a contact in JustCall with a first name and phone number, and optional last name, company, email, address and notes. Creates a new record each time. POST /v2.1/contacts.

tools.name: justcall_update_contact_status
tools.description: Add or remove one existing contact (by id or phone number) from the DND, DNM or blacklist lists. Adding a list twice gives the same result. PUT /v2.1/contacts/status.

tools.name: justcall_list_texts
tools.description: List SMS messages, optionally filtered by phone numbers, direction, content or date range. GET /v2.1/texts.

tools.name: justcall_get_text
tools.description: Get one SMS by id: direction, agent number, contact number and delivery status. GET /v2.1/texts/{id}.

tools.name: justcall_list_text_threads
tools.description: List SMS threads for one SMS-enabled JustCall phone number. Use justcall_list_phone_numbers to find its phone_id. GET /v2.1/texts/threads.

tools.name: justcall_send_sms
tools.description: Send one SMS from a JustCall number to one contact number. It is sent at once unless schedule_at is set. A sent SMS cannot be recalled. POST /v2.1/texts/new.

tools.name: justcall_list_phone_numbers
tools.description: List the JustCall phone numbers on the account with their ids, capabilities and assigned agents. Use these ids and numbers in the other tools. GET /v2.1/phone-numbers.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: justcall_list_texts, justcall_list_text_threads · Private data: justcall_list_calls, justcall_list_contacts, justcall_get_contact, justcall_create_contact, justcall_update_contact_status, justcall_get_text, justcall_send_sms · Public sink: justcall_create_contact, justcall_list_texts, justcall_get_text, justcall_list_text_threads, justcall_send_sms · Destructive: justcall_update_contact_status.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: justcall_list_texts, justcall_list_text_threads · Private data: justcall_list_calls, justcall_list_contacts, justcall_get_contact, justcall_create_contact, justcall_update_contact_status, justcall_get_text, justcall_send_sms · Public sink: justcall_create_contact, justcall_list_texts, justcall_get_text, justcall_list_text_threads, justcall_send_sms · Destructive: justcall_update_contact_status

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
